consequence.statement: Values populated in the runtime config file's `default` block are no longer honoured because the block was removed; defaults must be set in `operational_config`.
consequence.remediation: Move default values into the top-level `operational_config` in the standard Loki config.

original.statement: The `default` block of the runtime overrides config file (added in 2.9) was removed; set default values in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config instead.

decision.reason: [ev-0316e25d4611] says the `default` block of the runtime overrides config file "was removed". It says this affects only users who populated that block, and that default values now go in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config. A removed key whose values must be moved elsewhere fits setting-ignored, and the proposed remediation matches the evidence. The evidence does not say whether Loki fails on the leftover block or silently ignores it, so a stronger failure kind would not be supported.
